date_text.description: Preserve all printed event dates and clock times in the evidence. Use null for a weekday-only timetable without calendar date/time.

location.description: Text: preserve the explicitly stated physical place or online destination (platform/portal/email); null only when absent, never infer a default platform. Images: copy room identifier/campus without Phòng:; never repair punctuation.

evidence.description: Full event source line including course, date and clock; for images retain weekday heading and cell transcript.
